    //==
    // # The remaining nine Catalan duals
    //
    // The Catalan solids the base catalog could
    // not name, each simply the Conway `Dual` of
    // its Archimedean partner — the same pairing the duals section records on the
    // kind sums. Together with the base catalog's four this names
    // all thirteen Catalans (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalan_solid).
    //
    // All are face-transitive, so their vertices sit at more than one radius: never
    // pass them through ProjectedToUnitSphere. The duals of the two snubs inherit
    // their source's chirality.

    // 24 isosceles triangles on 14 vertices: the dual of the truncated
    // octahedron (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tetrakis_hexahedron).
    TetrakisHexahedron(_: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedOctahedron.Dual;
